text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonia accepts American South Eastern European cooperation Initiative (SECI) for closer economic cooperation in the region which differs from an European approach. Macedonian Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckoski stated that "Macedonia cannot escape from the region it exists in".

- "Macedonia would immediately accept the Finnish model for resolution of interethnic tensions and problems of education of national minorities, if only it had Sweden and Norway for neighbours," the paper comments U.N. Special Human Rights Rapporteur Elisabeth Rehn's statement in which she cited Finland as an example for resolution of ethnic issues.
- The Council of Europe to open human rights office in Skopje soon.
- The Macedonian direction for civil aviation to be received as full member of the corresponding European association.

- Ethnic Albanian PDP party said "Macedonian students' protests against Albanian-language classes at the Teacher's academy are a disgrace for the country". Opposition democratic party thinks that the "demonstrations are only part of general manipulation and result of the fear of governments to resolve this problem in parliament".
